name: One-Page Map
author: ernes
description: Adds a clearer, optional whole-act map view for Slay the Spire 2. The flat map is the game's own vertical map compressed to fit every node of the act on one screen — same rooms, same connections, same art style — with your current spot, legal next moves, and past route all called out, plus the game's legend. Room icons stay full-strength: future rooms wear a band of their type colour, legal next moves pulse with a white border, and an optional toggle (off by default) fades rooms you can no longer reach. Supports the game's map drawings (draw/erase/clear) and quest markers (e.g. Fur Coat). It changes visibility and UI layout only—it does not change cards, routes, travel rules, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay. Press M for the map and F to switch map styles; checkboxes on the map configure the view. Targets Slay the Spire 2 v0.110.1.
